fatal: W1 — TerminalWick covariance measurability is an additional hypothesis, not an implicit consequence of the stated TeX assumptions. Lean TerminalWick.lean:618 requires 'hK : Measurable fun q => K q.1 q.2'; the formula theorem has the same requirement at 392. TeX manuscript/notes/notes_stratonovich_ham_second_moment.tex:3601-3605 assumes a centered real Gaussian field, bounded variance, and joint mean-square continuity only 'on each open cell' of a finite time partition.
